title: When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.05513v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. Given that deploying powerful proprietary models remains commercially cost-prohibitive, practitioners must rely on lightweight local models that evolve post-deployment via online teaching from a stronger teacher. However, standard interactive feedback imposes prohibitive costs. We show that conventional trajectory-level preference optimization wastes budget on both unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns. To resolve these inefficiencies, we propose \textbf{Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming}, a budget-aware framework that systematically orchestrates \textbf{when} and \textbf{what} to teach. translated_title: 何时教与教什么：面向网络智能体的预算感知在线适应
translated_abstract: 网络智能体在自动化复杂互联网任务方面已取得显著成功，但将其部署到真实环境中需要持续的在线适应。鉴于部署强大的专有模型在商业上成本过高，从业者必须依赖轻量级本地模型，这些模型在部署后通过来自更强教师模型的在线教学不断进化。然而，标准的交互式反馈会带来难以承受的成本。我们证明了传统的轨迹级偏好优化会在不可解决的回合和冗余的执行步骤上浪费预算。为解决这些低效问题，我们提出了“带预算轨迹修剪的分数引导在线教学”，这是一个预算感知框架，系统地编排何时教和教什么。具体而言，我们的框架集成了一个可解性感知的教师门控来决定何时查询教师模型，以及一个分数引导的轮（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种预算感知的在线教学框架，通过可解性感知的教师门控决定何时查询教师模型，并通过分数引导的轨迹修剪筛选教学内容，从而避免在不可解决的回合和冗余执行步骤上浪费训练预算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a budget-aware online teaching framework for web agents that uses a solvability-aware teacher gate to determine when to query the teacher and score-guided trajectory trimming to decide what to teach, avoiding budget waste on unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns.
